observedOn: an isolated v0.5.1.1 lab engine on a development host (its own volume and root key, reached through an ssh tunnel), in throwaway accounts that were deleted afterwards (the account name is written as `evimed`, as the production account is named). They held only records written for these recordings; no user memory or document was read or written.

The exchanges `apps/server/src/openVikingClient.mjs` makes through its five original calls, recorded on 2026-10-23 by running that client itself (`packages/contracts/openviking/record.mjs`, which builds no request of its own for them) — every request body is the one the client builds — and saved as the bare response body the server sent, re-indented. `find.json` is trimmed to its first three hits of four written; nothing was added, renamed or invented.
layout.memory/: The exchanges of native memory, sessions, the admin routes and the MCP endpoint, recorded by `record.mjs` against the lab (`task-failed.json` and `archive-failed-marker-read.json` could not be recorded again and stay as recorded on v0.5.0: see `notRecorded`). Each file is `{ note, recordedFrom, request, status, contentType, response }`; `memory/_index.json` lists them and `memory/provenance.json` says how they were taken and what the wire disagreed with the documentation about.
layout.knowledge/: Response bodies (and the binary downloads) of resources, Compile, tasks, search, skills and the checked batch write, recorded by `record.mjs` against the lab. Each file is the bare body; `knowledge/provenance.json` holds the method, path, request body and status of every one.
layout.engine/: The control plane's engine check (`apps/server/src/openVikingEngine.mjs`) run against the lab twice, exchange by exchange: as an account the server had never seen (`engine-check-new-volume`: registration pending, the two skills installed) and as the same account once registered (`engine-check-ready`). `engine-check-no-templates.json` stays as recorded on v0.5.0: it needs a server that mounts no template directory.

fixtureEvidence: Recording rather than authoring is deliberate: a hand-written fixture once certified a shape the wire never produced and defeated the audit that depended on it. The two subdirectories keep the shape their recorder wrote so that nothing was transcribed by hand on the way in.

recordedExchanges.note: trimmed to the first three hits of four

configuration.embedding: dashscope / qwen3.7-text-embedding, dimension 1024, the production pin
configuration.vlm: provider openai, model deepseek-flash, thinking disabled through extra_request_body; in production the same block points at the control plane's model gateway with a service bearer
configuration.server.user_config_defaults: memory_policy.memory_types = the eight types; auto_commit_policy = idle 900 s, 150000 tokens, 100 messages
configuration.container: the lab's own container: not hardened as production is (the lab's uid, no memory limit), the built-in bot on with command execution off, no identity shim and no `compile_api` section

observations: Trusted mode with root_api_key set requires X-API-Key on EVERY request, not only when asserting a role as the multi-tenant documentation implies. A client sending only the account and user headers is refused with UNAUTHENTICATED; find-unauthenticated.json is that refusal, unchanged since v0.4.19.

A `content/write` under `memories/` returns semantic_status 'skipped' and vector_status 'complete' even with a language model configured (content-write.json): the derived recall index costs one embedding per record and no model call. Directory abstracts under it read '[Directory abstract is not ready]' (fs-ls.json).

A find score is (cosine + 1) / 2, as since v0.4.22. On four records the relevant hit scored 0.894, a same-kind record about another habit 0.763, an unrelated analysis 0.700 and an unrelated note 0.623 (the fourth, trimmed from find.json) — the same four numbers on v0.5.0 and v0.5.1.1, so the scale did not move. The production volume rehearsed under v0.5.0 on 2026-10-12 returned the same entries and hits as v0.4.19 with every score equal to (old + 1) / 2, so OPEN_SCIENCE_MEMORY_SEARCH_MIN_SCORE stays 0.75.

`ls` is not recursive. Listing `.../memories/evimed/user` on a tree written as `<kind>/<id>.md` returns the kind directories, each with `isDir: true` (fs-ls.json), not the leaves (fs-ls-leaves.json is one of them). `has_more` is a top-level key beside `result`. A missing directory answers 404 NOT_FOUND (fs-ls-missing.json).

A delete of something already gone answers 200 with `estimated_deleted_count: 0` (fs-delete-missing.json), not 404 as it did at v0.4.19. The client reads the count, so its callers' 'removed' counters stay true. Since v0.5.1 both answers also carry a `task_id` (the cleanup of the parent directory), which the client does not read.

A user cannot delete its own namespace root (`viking://user/<id>`): 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'Deleting a namespace root requires root access; use a concrete content path instead.' Everything below it can be deleted recursively.
/health reports `version`, `auth_mode` and `root_api_key_required` and is answered without a credential (health.json).

An unknown ov.conf key only warns at start (since v0.4.22); a memory-template directory that is not mounted is silent — the server falls back to its built-in types. The control plane therefore reads the engine's facts itself (apps/server/src/openVikingEngine.mjs): the per-type template route answers 400 'not editable' for a type the mounted directory added and 404 when the directory was not loaded.

Since v0.5.1 the server forwards the caller's account and user to its Compile runtime: a compile submitted as a user runs as that user with no identity shim and no `compile_api` section in ov.conf (the server then watches its Compile runtime every 30 s, so a finished task is seen up to 30 s late). A `to` or a `from` in another user's root is refused at submission with 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; a `to` under the account-shared `viking://resources/…` or `viking://agent/…` is accepted and runs, which the shim of the v0.5.0 pin used to refuse by rule (the control plane does now). A submission whose source is an existing empty directory fails with `INTERNAL: Compile sources contain no files` before any model is called (knowledge/provenance.json, the engine check's probe).
The container tag is v0.5.1.1 while the PyPI version is 0.5.1.1; the unprefixed tag does not exist. `/health` says `v0.5.1.1`, with the `v`.
The server refuses to start in dev auth mode when bound to 0.0.0.0, which is why the deployment uses trusted mode rather than a localhost bind.

`content/write` with `mode: replace` on a file that is not there creates it, parents included, under `resources/` and under `memories/`; `mode: create` is an alias of `replace` (no 409 on an existing file). `fs/mkdir` on a directory that exists is 409 CONFLICT.

The `timeout` field of `content/write` and `batch-write` is gone from the request model (an unknown field is refused), so `OpenVikingClient.write` sends none: the recorded request of content-write.json carries uri, content, mode and wait only.
notRecorded: task-failed.json and archive-failed-marker-read.json (memory/): an extraction whose model call is refused needs a model gateway that refuses it, and the lab's gateway is not this repository's to switch; they stay as recorded on v0.5.0.
engine-check-no-templates.json (engine/): needs a server that mounts no template directory.

A server with no Compile runtime (the built-in bot not started): the lab has one and it is configured, so the `configured: false` answer of `GET /compile/capabilities` and the 503 at submission are authored in the engine check's tests, and said to be there.
